description: This file defines the Zend_Http_CookieJar class, which manages HTTP cookies within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for adding cookies, parsing responses to extract cookies, retrieving cookies in various formats, and matching cookies to specific URIs.

classes.name: Zend_Http_CookieJar
classes.description: A class for managing HTTP cookies, including adding, retrieving, and matching cookies based on URI and other criteria.

methods.name: addCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the jar, accepting either a Zend_Http_Cookie object or a string.

methods.name: addCookiesFromResponse
methods.description: Parses an HTTP response to extract and add cookies set in the response.

methods.name: getAllCookies
methods.description: Returns all cookies in the jar in the specified format.

methods.name: getMatchingCookies
methods.description: Retrieves cookies matching a specific URI, considering session cookies and expiry.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.description: Retrieves a specific cookie by URI and name, in the specified format.

methods.name: _flattenCookiesArray
methods.description: Recursively flattens a nested array of cookies into a simple array or string.

methods.name: _matchDomain
methods.description: Filters cookies to those matching a specific domain.

methods.name: _matchPath
methods.description: Filters cookies to those matching a specific path within matched domains.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Creates a CookieJar instance from an HTTP response, optionally associating it with a URI.
